items.claim: An access-token endpoint that falls back to a privileged role when no matching user record is found grants privilege by default, and the proof is obtaining a token for an email the directory does not know.
items.body:
An access-token endpoint that falls back to a privileged role when no matching user record is found grants privilege by default, and the proof is obtaining a token for an email the directory does not know.

HackTricks reference: 309098c3 (notion:309098c3-95c5-80d1-8293-e4676890d458)
items.disproof: Requesting a token for an unknown email is rejected outright, or the issued token carries no elevated role, showing the default-privilege path is not reachable.
